label: Data Sources
description: Every app, database, cloud account and file store that could hold personal data — connected, scanned, and tagged where PII is found. Scans are read-only and sampled.
emptyDescription: Connect an app, database, cloud account or file store and Jethur scans it for personal data. Everything downstream — Data Map, RoPA, notices — is built from what these scans find.
noResultsDescription: Try a different search term, or clear the status and type filters.
footerReadOnly: Read-only · sampled · no data leaves your region
toastConnectStarted: Connecting {name} — first scan starts right after
wizardDescription: Connect an app, database, cloud account or file store so Jethur can scan it for personal data. Scans are read-only and sampled — nothing leaves your region.
wizardChooseDescription: Pick a data source to scan. Every connector below is live — connect a real source to scan it.
wizardSearchConnectors: Search {count} connectors — Tally, Razorpay, Darwinbox, greytHR, S3…
wizardNoMatchDescription: Use Other app (REST API) to connect it by API key.
catAppDescription: Accounting, ERP, HR & payroll, CRM, payments, support, marketing and logistics — the Indian SME stack plus the global apps you run alongside it.
catCloudDescription: Point us at a cloud account and we auto-discover buckets, managed databases and other stores inside it.
catDbDescription: Connect a database directly with a read-only user and choose which schemas to analyse.
catFileDescription: SMB / SFTP shares, IMAP mailboxes, server log directories and backup archives.
wizardConnectDbDescription: Enter host and credentials, then choose which databases to analyse.
wizardConnectDescription: Enter the connection details for this source.
dbPasswordHint: Optional — leave blank for trust or peer authentication.
dbPanelDescription: Enter host and credentials first, then load the databases from the server.
dbModeAllDescription: Scan every database visible to this role.
dbModeSelectedDescription: Pick one or more databases from the list below.
saveCredentialsLabel: Save password and keys in this browser
saveCredentialsDescription: Only when you explicitly agree. Otherwise secrets are never stored and you are asked for them on every rescan.
cloudReadOnlyDescription: The role or credentials only need List and Read permissions. We never request write access.
wizardScanDescription: How deeply and how often should we scan {name}?
samplingDescription: Deeper scans find more but take longer. You can change this at any time.
scheduleDescription: Scans run read-only, in off-peak hours (IST).
detectorsDescription: Identifiers are masked in previews; raw values never leave the source.
wizardReviewDescription: Confirm the details — the first scan starts right after connecting.
reviewDatabasesAll: All databases visible to this role
credentialsNotStored: Not stored — asked for on each rescan
readOnlyAccessDescription: The scanner never modifies your data. Access is logged in the audit trail.
detailZeroCopyDescription: Jethur stores only locations, counts and masked samples of personal data. Raw values are read in memory during a scan and never persisted — your PII stays in {name}.
detailSampleDescription: Connect this source to see real findings.
detailWhereFeedsDescription: Findings flow automatically into your compliance registers.
findingsCleanTitle: No PII detected in the latest scan
findingsCleanDescription: Nothing to act on here. The next scheduled scan will check again.
findingsEmptyDescription: Connect this source and the first scan lists every location where personal data is found.
findingsSampleNotice: Sample rows — illustrative only. Your real findings appear here after the first scan.
findingsFooterMasked: Samples are masked at the source during scanning — raw values are never transmitted or stored.
toastOpenExternal: Opens {location} in {name} — we store the pointer, not the data
historyEmptyDescription: Connect this source to run your first scan — every run is logged here for 24 months as s.8(5) audit evidence.
detailHistoryRetention: Retention: scan logs are kept 24 months for audit (s.8(5) evidence).
toastScanReport: Scan report generated — methodology and counts only, no PII
configConnectionDescription: Credentials are encrypted; the token has read-only scope.
configConnectionOffDescription: Enter read-only credentials to connect this source.
configScopeDescription: Toggle to include or exclude. Excluded items are never read.
configSaveHint: Changes apply from the next scan.
configDangerDescription: Disconnecting stops all scans. Historical scan logs and finding locations are kept for your audit trail — no PII is held either way.
toastScopeUpdated: Scope updated — applies from the next scan
toastConfigSaved: Configuration saved — the next scan uses the new settings
